description.value: Using selectively visible lighting and even voice clips to elicit pathos, you draw attention to a character's most daunting and desperate moment. When you @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set the Spotlight} on yourself, you can @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.ttL2TstfSqOyzCd2]{Cast a Role} to apply the drama role to yourself as a free action. As long as you are in a spotlight with the drama role, you do not take the role's status penalty and you can use Performance in place of Athletics to [[/act escape skill=performance]] or [[/act force-open skill=performance]], or to [[/act shove skill=performance]] a creature who used a hostile action against you within the last round.
